values.goal: Split #203 and publish the authority-store security boundary as a focused runtime remediation slice.
values.required_outcome: Raw certificate, lease, and fencing store access is sealed behind typed authority access tokens; authority-bound adapter and published receipt view are reviewable without the broader #203 transport/peripheral/lifecycle monolith.
declared_scope: direct raw-store test fixture callers required to compile after sealing
authority_boundary: Raw store mutation/open APIs require typed authority access tokens.
Production publication still requires typed C-SDLC review and publish; Gemini review is advisory evidence only.
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle and GitHub routes.
Leave closeout/background bookkeeping to the background lane.
